name: Air France
max_carrier_dimensions: Soft-sided bag, max 46 x 28 x 24 cm (per Air France's official cabin checklist PDF, Oct 2025)
max_combined_weight: 8 kg (17.64 lb) pet + carrier in cabin; over 8 kg and up to 75 kg (165.35 lb) must travel in the hold
checked_or_cargo: Yes: pets over 8 kg and up to 75 kg with carrier travel in the hold (subject to availability).
notes: Add your pet at least 24 hours before departure (48 hours for dogs to the U.S.); late requests carry a 25-50% surcharge. Fee amounts are shown in a dynamic section our fetcher could not read. Extra source: https://img.static-af.com/m/581dcafaaa04ab97/original/Travel-Pets-Checklist-EN.pdf
